# The tests of api stay red after the bump and after two fix rounds. The run waits for a person. The answer hold ends the run: the log has a red row,
# the item is on hold, and nothing reaches the remote or the forge. The report names the red repository.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
maintinit
maintfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env GIT_BASE=file://$WORK/remotes
env UPKEEP_WEEK=2026-W44
# A failed script leaves its run in the wait for an answer. The short deadline ends that run, so no process outlives the script.
env RED_TIMEOUT=90s
cp repos-api.tsv home/.upkeep/repos.tsv

exec sh home/.upkeep/scripts/tick.sh &
waitstatus 'The tests of api fail after the bump'
exec obee status
stdout 'item-bump-api-2026-W44-r1\trunning\tpaused: .*The tests of api fail'
! grep 'pr create' gh.log
exec obee answer bump-api-2026-W44 hold
wait
stdout 'item bump-api-2026-W44 finished'

# Two fix rounds ran, then the gate ran one more time. The hold asked for no further round.
grep -count=1 '^update$' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^fix$' calls.log
grep -count=3 '^go test' tools.log
grep '^2026-W44\tapi\tred\t\tthe tests fail after the bump\t' home/.upkeep/runs.tsv
! exists home/.upkeep/state/api.env
! exec git -C remotes/acme/api show upkeep/api-2026-W44
! grep 'gh pr create' gh.log
exec obee item list api
stdout -count=1 'bump-api-2026-W44'
exec obee status
stdout 'item-bump-api-2026-W44-r1\tdone'

# The report counts the red row.
grep '1 repositories listed. 0 opened a pull request, 0 skipped, 1 failed the gate,' home/.upkeep/reports/2026-W44.md
grep '^- api: red' home/.upkeep/reports/2026-W44.md

-- repos-api.tsv --
api	acme/api	main	gotestsum --junitfile reports/junit.xml -- ./...
-- gate-results --
red
red
red
-- fixtures/go-api.json --
{"Path":"acme/api","Main":true}
{"Path":"example.com/lib","Version":"v1.2.0","Update":{"Path":"example.com/lib","Version":"v1.3.0"}}
